mapper.select: SELECT t.session_id, t.turn_id, t.started_at, t.ended_at, t.state, s.state session_state, b.path_status transcript_path_status, b.session_check_status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM execution_tool_call x WHERE x.session_id=t.session_id AND x.turn_id=t.turn_id) tool_count, 0 otel_tool_count FROM execution_turn t JOIN execution_session s ON s.session_id=t.session_id LEFT JOIN transcript b ON b.meta_session_id=t.session_id WHERE t.turn_id=#{turnId}

SELECT session_id, turn_id, tool_use_id, tool_name, pre_observed_at, post_observed_at, state, estimated_duration_ms, duration_valid, version FROM execution_tool_call WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} ORDER BY COALESCE(pre_observed_at, post_observed_at), tool_use_id

SELECT id, delivery_id, observed_at, raw_json, parse_status FROM execution_raw_hook_event WHERE (JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(raw_json, '$.turn_id')) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin)=#{turnId} ORDER BY observed_at, id

SELECT DISTINCT o.id, o.signal_type, o.trace_id, o.span_id, o.turn_id, o.call_id, o.object_kind, o.duration_ms, o.event_time, o.received_at, o.raw_json, o.parse_status FROM telemetry_record o LEFT JOIN trace_telemetry_alignment a ON a.telemetry_record_id=o.id LEFT JOIN execution_tool_call h ON a.target_type='TOOL_CALL' AND a.session_id=h.session_id AND a.turn_id=h.turn_id AND a.tool_use_id=h.tool_use_id WHERE o.turn_id=#{turnId} OR h.turn_id=#{turnId} ORDER BY COALESCE(o.event_time,o.received_at)

SELECT a.id, CASE WHEN a.target_type='TOOL_CALL' THEN 'TOOL' ELSE 'TURN' END hook_node_type, COALESCE(a.tool_use_id,a.turn_id) hook_node_id, a.telemetry_record_id otel_object_id, a.level, a.evidence_json, a.algorithm_version, a.time_delta_ms FROM trace_telemetry_alignment a JOIN execution_tool_call h ON a.target_type='TOOL_CALL' AND a.session_id=h.session_id AND a.turn_id=h.turn_id AND a.tool_use_id=h.tool_use_id WHERE h.turn_id=#{turnId} ORDER BY a.id
